import numpy as np

# Extract the relevant columns for analysis
education_expenditure = adjusted_savings_df.filter(regex='YR').values
gni_per_capita = gni_per_capita_df.filter(regex='YR').values
economic_output = exports_df.filter(regex='YR').values

# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and per capita GDP
correlation_education_gni = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, gni_per_capita)[0, 1]

# Calculate the correlation between per capita GDP and economic output
correlation_gni_output = np.corrcoef(gni_per_capita, economic_output)[0, 1]

correlation_education_gni, correlation_gni_output

# Check for missing values in the economic_output dataset
economic_output_missing = np.isnan(economic_output).sum()
economic_output_missing

# Remove rows with missing values in the economic_output dataset
economic_output_clean = economic_output[~np.isnan(economic_output).any(axis=1)]

# Recalculate the correlation between per capita GDP and economic output
gni_per_capita_clean = gni_per_capita[~np.isnan(economic_output).any(axis=1)]
correlation_gni_output_clean = np.corrcoef(gni_per_capita_clean, economic_output_clean)[0, 1]

correlation_gni_output_clean
